# Vendored sRDI (reflective DLL loader for `kind: shellcode`)

Picaro's `build.output.kind: shellcode` wraps the packed DLL in a reflective
loader so the output is raw, position-independent bytes. That loader comes from
[sRDI](https://github.com/monoxgas/sRDI) (commit
`9fdd5c44383039519accd1e6bac4acd5a046a92c`), vendored here as source instead of
downloaded, with three fixes the upstream Python no longer matches:

- **`ShellcodeRDI.c`** — the C reflective loader, extended to *provision
  thread-local storage* for the mapped DLL (upstream only runs TLS callbacks,
  not TLS data). A Rust `#[thread_local]` otherwise reads an uninitialized slot
  and aborts. The block is written into `TEB->ThreadLocalStoragePointer`
  (`gs:[0x58]`), the array a CRT reads — never `TlsSetValue`, which writes
  `TEB->TlsSlots` — and the slot is restored before the thread exits so ntdll's
  teardown does not try to free our private block. See
  `docs/design/shellcode-output.md` and `docs/measurements.md` ("TLS
  provisioning for a manually mapped image").
- **`build_blob.py`** — compiles `ShellcodeRDI.c` with MinGW-w64, extracts the
  position-independent `.text` as the x64 loader blob and emits `ShellcodeRDI.py`
  (the converter Picaro imports). It also corrects the x64 bootstrap, whose 5th
  and 6th argument slots were swapped upstream (a pointer was fed into `dwFlags`,
  which made the loader `Sleep` for thousands of seconds after resolving
  imports).
- **`ConvertToShellcode.py`** — the unmodified upstream CLI driver, kept so the
  packer can invoke the converter as a subprocess.
- **`ShellcodeRDI.py`** — generated by `build_blob.py` (the corrected bootstrap
  plus the compiled loader blob). Committed too, so a host build can point
  `PICARO_SRDI` at this directory without running MinGW first; the Docker image
  regenerates it from `ShellcodeRDI.c`.

## Regenerate `ShellcodeRDI.py`

```sh
python3 vendor/srdi/build_blob.py vendor/srdi/ShellcodeRDI.c \
    -o /usr/local/lib/srdi/ShellcodeRDI.py
```

The Docker image runs exactly this at build time (see `Dockerfile`). It needs
`x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc`, `x86_64-w64-mingw32-objcopy`, `x86_64-w64-mingw32-ld`
and a Python 3.
